data.description:
## Summary
CI for Gerrit change 2480 exposed a py3.11 xdist leak: `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py::test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip` creates `.rebar-test-sidecar-material` under `Path.cwd()` / repo root. During xdist, another test can snapshot repo root while that directory exists and fail in `tests/conftest.py::_no_repo_root_leaks`.

## Root cause
The test fixture should use a per-test temporary directory, not the checkout root. Its current repo-root scratch directory is briefly visible to unrelated tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip` writes its synthetic tracker under `tmp_path`, not `Path.cwd()` / repo root.
- [ ] The targeted sidecar-material test passes.
- [ ] The 29a6 Gerrit Verified gate no longer fails on `.rebar-test-sidecar-material` repo-root leakage.

## Testing
- `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py::test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip -q`
- Gerrit change 2480 Verified rerun.
data.title: Completion sidecar material test leaks repo-root scratch dir under xdist
